parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: Required. The end time in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The default value is yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00. The maximum query interval is 90 days.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Required. The start time in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The default value is yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00. The maximum query interval is 90 days.
